The villa is arranged over three spacious levels and built around seamless indoor outdoor living. Floor to ceiling pocket doors slide completely into the walls, opening the main living space directly onto the private garden and heated pool area, creating a bright and open environment perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The ground floor features a double bedroom with en suite bathroom and a guest toilet. Upstairs, the master bedroom includes an en suite bathroom, while two additional bedrooms share a bathroom. All three bedrooms have direct access to an upper terrace providing additional outdoor space. The lower level offers further privacy with two large bedrooms, each with dressing room and en suite bathroom. There is also a bedroom with two single beds that can be joined upon request. This level includes a separate laundry room, storage area, a fully equipped private gym and a sauna with shower and toilet. Outside, the landscaped garden includes an outdoor dining area, lounge space and sun loungers surrounding the private heated swimming pool. Guests have exclusive access to the entire villa, garden, pool and garage, with private parking available for up to two vehicles. Neighborhood info La Finca de Marbella is a modern, secure residential community located just east of Marbella town centre. The villa is situated within the newer phase of the development, known for its contemporary architecture, landscaped streets and peaceful atmosphere. Guests appreciate the calm residential setting while being only a short drive from Marbella’s beaches, golf courses and restaurants. Marbella Old Town is easily accessible, and Puerto Banús can be reached in approximately 15–20 minutes by car. The area is recognised for its privacy, well-maintained surroundings and family-friendly environment, making it ideal for guests seeking a relaxed stay close to the best of the Costa del Sol. # Villas in Marbella with private spa and wellness facilities

Discover villas in Marbella designed for wellness, featuring private spas, indoor pools and tranquil spaces.

Written by [Alex Clover](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/about/team/alex-clover "Alex Clover")

23rd March 2026·6 min. read

![Heated indoor pool and lounge area in one of the most exclusive villas in Marbella with spa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUazke0ZLtPvmqmRZRdC~BulBFiCkWnkYM1BKvHylY7L7hIf6B_TzxlY1BAl3daeqXSIcfhztSPxHB~jUsrNmkFMYSkHtxXaqECkSyfWjwY93nA--.jpg)

## Homes designed for wellness: 8 luxury villas in Marbella with private spas

While Marbella has long been associated with outdoor lifestyle, sunshine and wellbeing, today’s buyers are increasingly seeking homes where relaxation, fitness and recovery are built directly into the architecture.

- Table of contents
- [Homes designed for wellness: 8 luxury villas in Marbella with private spas](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#homes+designed+for+wellness+8+luxury+villas+in+marbella+with+private+spas)
- [1\. Villa Horizon – Marbella Hill Club](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#1+villa+horizon++marbella+hill+club)
- [2\. Contemporary villa in Sierra Blanca](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#2+contemporary+villa+in+sierra+blanca)
- [3\. Luxury villa in El Herrojo Alto, La Quinta](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#3+luxury+villa+in+el+herrojo+alto+la+quinta)
- [4\. Villa La Quinta 20 – Lomas de La Quinta](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#4+villa+la+quinta+20++lomas+de+la+quinta)
- [5\. Estate villa in El Madroñal](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#5+estate+villa+in+el+madronal)
- [6\. Renovated contemporary villa in Nueva Andalucía](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#6+renovated+contemporary+villa+in+nueva+andalucia)
- [7\. Beachside villa in Los Monteros](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#7+beachside+villa+in+los+monteros)
- [8\. Contemporary villa in Nueva Andalucía with spa suite](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#8+contemporary+villa+in+nueva+andalucia+with+spa+suite)
- [The new era of luxury living in Marbella is all about wellness](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/news/villas-in-marbella-with-spa#the+new+era+of+luxury+living+in+marbella+is+all+about+wellness)

Across the Costa del Sol, a growing number of luxury villas now incorporate private spa facilities, from heated indoor pools, saunas, hammams and massage rooms to gyms, yoga studios and tranquil relaxation areas. These spaces transform the home into a personal sanctuary, allowing residents to maintain wellness routines on their terms.

![Woman relaxing in a bubbling jacuzzi in a luxury Marbella villa with private spa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUa3uF3qroo2Ve6H58SBK1pmR8zbO2TfEugsoM_UzYt0dIxqmFcW_iu8hATt~CGVHRDxr5LSSRtsJ0ugwplk~Keo52ZR74L0X8Jr7hhjOab~fKuOHYttdpnzOogg-.jpg)

Prime buyers are no longer looking solely for impressive architecture or panoramic views. Increasingly, they are choosing homes designed around balance, health and everyday wellbeing, where a morning swim, sauna, or meditation session can become part of daily life effortlessly.

From the hills of Benahavís to Marbella’s prestigious residential neighbourhoods, several villas currently on the market offer exceptional wellness facilities. Below is a curated selection where spa-inspired living forms an integral part of the home itself.

## 1\. Villa Horizon – Marbella Hill Club

5 bedrooms \| 6 bathrooms + 2 guest toilets \| 1,292 total m2 (inc. terraces) \| €14,995,000

A private wellness sanctuary on Marbella’s Golden Mile, located within the exclusive Marbella Hill Club.

![Contemporary luxury home at sunset with pool, featured among the best villas in Marbella with spa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUa4ygUekbUNmRNdWpBvPOR6AiZS54rgTiE_VeiP38IGt845qct0ZA0zn49aNd7Rt7bARV1iNrMx98PsS6tZj3GEF_wICjEaNTPMYKtBS_qFLo_O38bpXta0Q0h8-.jpg) Villa Horizon

Villa Horizon includes an entire level dedicated to relaxation and leisure, featuring a fully equipped gym, sauna, Turkish bath and massage room, alongside a cinema and entertainment space. Natural materials and soft lighting create an atmosphere closer to a boutique spa than a typical residential wellness area.

![Elegant lounge and home cinema overlooking a private indoor pool in a Marbella spa villa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUa_K3Nqh1BUNyipNL~NnJzmajxh~xsQGwH6T0BkKt3tGBWEUu32pY9cMwLm6Am25kaoeLsQsc9fIoNpLUiHmEfgH9nUHyI7KE8PL4dSGhuEdznEVJDsqkOvfoQg-.jpg) The villa has a whole level dedicated to wellness

With generous terraces and sweeping views across the Mediterranean, the property offers a lifestyle where wellness and comfort are seamlessly integrated into everyday living.

**View all information about this property:**

**[Villa Horizon in Marbella Hill Club](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/properties/marbella/marbella-golden-mile/marbella-hill-club/villas/PANR-16015)**

## 2\. Contemporary villa in Sierra Blanca

7 bedrooms \| 7 bathrooms + 8 guest toilets \| 1,320 total m2 (inc. terraces) \| €10,970,000

![Grand modern mansion with outdoor pool and garden, one of the finest villas in Marbella with spa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUah5y_zeGmVuetiN4oQoWqsMLikinpEa89NyEboKPYx~nm5pnLRE4_KNigDQba9d653mCpdhf1H950DtQiTi~0oURUBg071Dh~jD6Wof9PBvPFNPxDqudwBFFMQ-.jpg)

Set in the prestigious residential enclave of Sierra Blanca, this contemporary villa combines elegant architecture with a thoughtfully designed wellness area. The property features a heated indoor swimming pool, hammam and sauna, gym and cinema room. Large windows allow natural light to fill the space, enhancing the calm atmosphere

![Minimalist indoor wellness pool with soft lighting in a luxury villa in Marbella with spa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUalj6Bo0QGURwOSHjotmnMbN4gB5cFALKqIU10_QA0JOH0esxrikqx~zAZEldFRY9~KR1XEJrKLLdUrYqePuas1Pz1_LUZi4jmhhio7rpc2AGwPeMJ~xCjZoz_M-.jpg) The heated indoor pool is an oasis of calm

Outside, an infinity pool is centred amidst expansive terraces and gardens, providing the perfect setting to relax while enjoying spectacular sea and mountain views. The property also features a rooftop terrace with dining area, jacuzzi and panoramic Mediterranean views.

**View all information about this property:**

**[Contemporary villa in Sierra Blanca](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/properties/marbella/marbella-golden-mile/sierra-blanca/villas/PANR-13116)**

## 3\. Luxury villa in El Herrojo Alto, La Quinta

6 bedrooms \| 7 bathrooms + 3 guest toilets \| 934 total m2 (inc. terraces) \| €10,995,000

A full retreat in the hills of La Quinta. This exceptional villa offers one of the most comprehensive private spa facilities currently available in the Marbella area.

![Private wellness area with sauna, plunge pools and plants inside a Marbella villa with spa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUaqixVMGhm~lCWG5_AG7XS4I8yyUtXAYjhyHxHSe9LtE8Ff1ifQwUfKbGF7sjrN6FAIDrVkmfnuO0x9LKL9kCYxlA3M76peYTDbhd8dhVCq4YyELC5Po1LbJCN0-.jpg) Part of the dedicated wellness area

The dedicated wellness level, which gives the impression of a chic boutique hotel spa, includes a heated indoor pool, steam room, sauna and professional massage space, as well as a spacious entertainment lounge and rare outdoor cinema. Wall-sized sliding glass doors allow natural light to enter the spa area while connecting the space with outdoor terraces and landscaped surroundings.

**View all information about this property:**

**[Luxury villa in El Herrojo Alto, La Quinta](https://www.panoramamarbella.com/properties/benahavis/la-quinta/villas/PANR-15658)**

## 4\. Villa La Quinta 20 – Lomas de La Quinta

6 bedrooms \| 7 bathrooms + 1 guest toilet \| 781 total m2 (inc. terraces) \| €7,450,000

Villa La Quinta 20 places wellbeing at the centre of its architectural concept with an entire floor dedicated to leisure and wellness, featuring a heated indoor pool, spa facilities and a fully equipped gym.

![Designer indoor spa pool with wooden deck and gym in a luxury Marbella villa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUavHsXheYrhA2frunVWTeyGIm1uMSmwv_zWQ_iRyZGleODKm8WNEnXG3vqH4X7VUL72UXFJn~3NmFnWKRiqDHZxJOrrzBkLX1wmUMMVULTGYi~AD5AZBl_yFGEY-.jpg) The heated indoor pool is adjacent to the gym

Designed to encourage both movement and relaxation, the space encourages residents to incorporate health and wellness naturally into their everyday lifestyle.

## 5\. Estate villa in El Madroñal

6 bedrooms \| 6 bathrooms + 2 guest toilets \| 858 total m2 (inc. terraces) \| €7,800,000

Set within the wooded hills of El Madroñal, this estate villa offers a more secluded interpretation of wellness living. The property features a high-tech indoor pool and spa area designed to evoke the atmosphere of a luxury resort. Surrounded by cork oak forests and mountain views, the setting enhances the sense of calm and privacy.

In this environment, wellness becomes closely connected to nature.

![Large indoor swimming pool with blue ceiling lighting in one of the top villas in Marbella with spa](https://media.panoramamarbella.com/imgV1/B95mbh8olwFQm~uCT2wPZMb8hll4wghQQQq6YWg0~c~U_DrmgY8pGP8pqaDzA6mvjyI_OPtcrHD_aKxAUQWwUaRuv8fsEk4OaMWL2d7_68xWLEh9fpwBAqmihRuoSebSXIk1nJ9n7WoPSX7qVab60I9tx3Ind5Gf1wzRAma6k31mC9UBKL023GE3ar~2ER4NM5TQSANSnpGLK9g-.jpg) The high tech indoor pool and spa area are like a luxury resort
